name: Can I fix a leaking kitchen sink myself, or should I call a professional plumber?

mainEntity.name: Can I fix a leaking kitchen sink myself, or should I call a professional plumber?

acceptedAnswer.text: While minor leaks, such as a loose drain nut, might be fixable for some DIY enthusiasts, many kitchen sink leaks are more complex. Issues like corroded pipes, faulty faucet cartridges, or damaged P-traps often require specialized tools and expertise to diagnose and repair correctly. A decision factor is whether you have the proper tools and experience; attempting complex repairs without them can exacerbate the problem, leading to water damage or necessitating a more extensive and expensive professional repair later.
acceptedAnswer.description: Minor leaks may be DIY-fixable, but complex issues often require professional help. Improper DIY can worsen the problem.
